messages.text: Morning all. Already had three members call in locked out of online banking since 7:45. All getting the "verify your identity" loop on MFA. Anyone else seeing this?
Yep, two here. One said the text code never arrives. I'm guessing this is MemberSSO since OnlineBanking relies on it for MFA. Core looks fine, I can pull up shares without issue.
Teller line has a member at my window who can't log in on mobile. Wants to move money between savings and checking. I can do it in branch, but should I also tell him to wait on resetting anything?
Joseph, yes please hold off on resets for now. Repeated resets can trigger more lockouts. Do the transfer at the window and note it in MemberCRM. I'm pinging IT in #it now.
Got {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0051}} on the phone, same issue. Verified by hand using the callback on file, and they're fine to wait. Logging it so we can count the tickets for IT.
Update: {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0001}} called back, said the code finally arrived at {{CLIENT_PHONE:c_0001}} but about 12 minutes late. So looks like delay rather than outright failure.
Thanks, that matches what Hector is seeing. SMS provider queue backed up on the MFA side. He says it's clearing. Keep tallying calls with a lockout tag and I'll send the count to IT by noon.
Will do. Count so far on my side is 6. I'll tell members to wait 5 minutes between code requests instead of hammering resend.
